body.title: Widen TurnExit, Marker's turn-end variant, parseMarker and endTurn's marker construction
body.summary: Add two new OPTIONAL vibe-outcome fields (dispatchState, outcome) to TurnExit and Marker's turn-end variant; widen parseMarker's turn-end case to parse and return them; widen endTurn's appendMarker call to include them (alongside the previously-discarded code/signal fields, which are already written but not yet exposed).
acceptanceChecks: Marker's turn-end variant and parseMarker's turn-end case both carry the two new optional vibe fields plus the previously-written-but-undeclared code/signal fields
a turn-end marker line written before this Story's build still parses successfully with the new fields simply absent

tests.name: parseMarker's turn-end case extracting code, signal, unknown, vibeDispatchState and vibeOutcome
